request.prompt:
A quiet Oasis civic interior or residential district near the lower salar edge, showing abundant services, clean infrastructure, automated transportation, and the social sparseness of a place where systems meet needs without necessarily creating community.

Must be shown, exactly as written: Oasis is near a lower salar edge within the same high-desert basin; do not make it a lush oasis in the ordinary geographic sense. `(world.md; rules/decisions.md)`

Not established, so your choice: A civic display may show established terms such as “ESSENTIAL ACCESS,” “PARTICIPATION,” “MOVEMENT AUTHORIZATION,” or “SYSTEM STABILITY,” but no new institutional names or legal categories should be invented as visible text.

Must not appear: Do not show Alpha as a single humanoid ruler. Alpha is a distributed federation of regional and corporate instances, presented institutionally through systems and interfaces. `(characters.md; world.md)`

No lettering of any kind: no captions, labels, signage, logos, numbers, speech balloons or on-screen text, unless the brief requires a specific one. Concept reference, not finished comic art; no panel borders.

Add nothing that tells a story of its own: no invented symbols, emblems, documents or events. Render the description, not an interpretation of it.
